integrity: The verifier reconstructs the full complex from all 99 tetrahedra, proves H1 is Z plus Z/2 by integral Smith reduction, certifies explicit free and torsion coordinates, and exhausts all graph triangles.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns simple edge cycles in the fixed published sixteen-vertex triangulation of G4. The splitting of H1 into a named free generator and torsion generator is chosen by explicit cocycles; only the resulting class multiplicities up to homology automorphism are intrinsic.
title: Four integral triangle types in the sixteen-vertex quarter-turn flat three-manifold
